Oscar Piastri's only Formula 1 teammate has been Lando Norris at McLaren (2023–2025). Norris won the 2025 drivers' championship, finishing on 423 points to Max Verstappen's 421, according to the 2025 final standings I retrieved.

ANSWER: Lando Norris
